amendment_1.tier_1_clarification: the Tier 1 label here means exactly: public-use data analyzed LOCALLY, in code, WITHOUT participant-level exposure to the AI orchestrator. It is NOT permission for the orchestrator to inspect the dataset: no participant-level record, value or row may appear in prompts, transcripts, logs, printed output, test fixtures or committed artifacts. Analysis code reads rows; every reported quantity is an aggregate; any reported count below 10 is suppressed as '<10' per the producer's tabulation rule.
operational_consequences_for_the_runner: no participant-level logging anywhere, enforced structurally and by test
aggregate-output disclosure guard: any tabulated cell, stratum or count with n < 10 is suppressed in every output
any temporary extraction file holds item columns only (no identifiers) and is deleted before the run ends

supersedes: configs/model/d9a_charter_draft.json (preserved; every TO_BE_FROZEN slot now filled)
scientific_question: Can the bit-identical frozen M8B model estimate five-dimensional scores and factor correlations on an unfamiliar real battery, without dataset-specific psychometric fitting, with close agreement to a separately fitted confirmatory multidimensional psychometric model?

dataset.release: ICPSR02760-v19, Ann Arbor, MI: Inter-university Consortium for Political and Social Research [distributor], 2020-09-28. doi:10.3886/ICPSR02760.v19
dataset.dataset_unit: DS0001 'Main, Siblings and Twin Data': 7,108 records, 2,098 variables (ICPSR manifest)
dataset.local_root: data/public/ICPSR_02760-V19 (MIDUS)/ICPSR_02760 (NEVER committed; hashes below are the binding reference)
dataset.integrity: local Data.sav and Codebook MD5s verified EQUAL to ICPSR's own distributed manifest checksums (a0a4b1a9..., 704ca821...)

access_tier.determination: TIER 1: public-use, de-identified, disclosure-controlled release distributed by ICPSR for research and statistical use to registered users; terms agreed by the account holder on 2026-08-07 (recorded in TermsOfUse.html, hashed above)
access_tier.terms_key_language: 'To use these datasets solely for research or statistical purposes and not for investigation of specific RESEARCH SUBJECTS'; no re-identification; no redistribution without agreement
access_tier.obligations: no re-identification or cross-source linkage to that end; raw participant-level files never committed; participant-level values never in logs, tests, fixtures, prompts, transcripts or committed artifacts - analysis reads rows in code, outputs report aggregates only

dataset.role_predeclaration: DEVELOPMENT for real-data gate derivation. Single-role rule: MIDUS is permanently excluded from serving as the locked independent replication.
dataset.d9_sign_off: the approval of this frozen charter by the project owner constitutes the D9 sign-off for opening DS0001 under the stated role

sample_definition.population: all DS0001 records (N=7,108: main RDD, siblings, twins - one pooled sample; no subsample selection)
sample_definition.inclusion: respondents with at least 2 of the 25 mapped items observed after missing-code handling (the M8 canonical minimum-observed rule)
sample_definition.exclusions_stated_prospectively: respondents with fewer than 2 observed mapped items - which includes the 783 'Respondent does not have SAQ data' (-1) cases documented in the codebook; the exact excluded count is REPORTED by the run, never adjusted
sample_definition.weights: unweighted; this is a measurement-agreement evaluation, not a population-descriptive analysis

item_mapping.source: transcribed verbatim from 02760-0001-Documentation-scales.pdf pp. 32-33 (PERSONALITY TRAITS; Lachman & Weaver 1997 MIDI scales) and the ICPSR codebook variable entries
item_mapping.instrument: Self-Administered Questionnaire, Section F, Question 4 (a-dd): 'Please indicate how well each of the following describes you.'
item_mapping.response_coding_raw: 1 A lot; 2 Some; 3 A little; 4 Not at all

missing_code_labels.-1: Respondent does not have SAQ data

item_mapping.excluded_from_mapping: the 5 Agency adjectives (A1SF4E Self-confident, A1SF4J Forceful, A1SF4O Assertive, A1SF4T Outspoken, A1SF4DD Dominant) - Agency is not a Big Five factor and is outside this charter
item_mapping.recode_rule_frozen: for every item, recoded = 5 - raw (so higher = more descriptive of the trait pole), EXCEPT the within_scale_negative items (A1SF4S Calm within Neuroticism; A1SF4X Careless within Conscientiousness) which keep recoded = raw; then categories map 1..4 -> 0..3 as canonical response indices; the IDENTICAL recoded matrix feeds both the model and the comparator

model.rule: the bit-identical M8B model, reproduced from the frozen trainer config and seeds and hash-asserted at launch; NO retraining, fine-tuning, calibration, threshold adjustment or any dataset-specific psychometric fitting on MIDUS
regime_notes_recorded_prospectively: dense by design: every SAQ respondent was administered all 30 adjectives - inside the validated dense regime; item-level refusals are ordinary missingness, not planned sparseness
items-per-factor is UNBALANCED (4/5/7/4/5) whereas training used balanced 5/8/12 - recorded as a transfer condition, not adjusted for
4 response categories: inside training support; N ~ 6,300 exceeds the training worlds' n <= 2,000, which is unproblematic for amortized inference and is recorded

comparator.specification: confirmatory five-factor graded-response model in mirt with the SAME frozen mapping: mirt.model with pairwise COV only, graded itemtype, QMCEM (K=5), NCYCLES 2000 TOL 1e-4, one MHRM retry then recorded nonconvergence, EAP scores with QMC, NA full-information, per-fit wall clock - the frozen M8 comparator specification unchanged
comparator.timeout: 3600 s under the repaired whole-tree enforcement
comparator.input: the identical recoded 25-item matrix the model receives

prespecified_metrics_no_gates.note: D9A is DEVELOPMENT for real-data gate derivation: all metrics are prespecified REPORTING with no pass/fail gate; thresholds for the later locked replication are frozen afterward, in their own charter, and never adjudicated against D9A
factor_specific_agreement: per-factor Pearson and Spearman correlation between model posterior means and comparator EAP scores, all five factors separately, never pooled; worst factor highlighted
per-factor correlation of both score sets with unit-weighted recoded scale composites (the Lachman-Weaver scoring), as a model-free anchor
phi_agreement: element-wise absolute differences between the model Phi and the comparator's estimated factor-correlation matrix: mean and max off-diagonal; PD and shrink usage of the model Phi reported
prespecified_metrics_no_gates.uncertainty_behavior: distribution of model posterior SDs per factor; ordinal association between SD and number of items answered; reported only
prespecified_metrics_no_gates.runtime: model inference wall-clock for the full sample vs comparator fit wall-clock, same machine
prespecified_metrics_no_gates.convergence_and_refusals: comparator convergence/retry recorded; model factor_adequacy status counts and warning counts reported as refusal behavior
prespecified_metrics_no_gates.aggregates_only: every reported quantity is an aggregate over respondents; no participant-level value appears in the report

governance.evaluated_once: one run against this charter, preserved verbatim; a pre-existing D9A report refuses a second run
governance.no_sparse_datasets: SAPA and ICAR remain untouched; sparse multidimensional administration is unsupported and out of scope
governance.training_prohibition: no training, fine-tuning, architecture selection, threshold alteration, recalibration or refusal-rule revision may use MIDUS
governance.raw_data_never_committed: the ICPSR package stays outside git; this charter carries its hashes as the binding reference
governance.runner_requirements: the M8B refusal pattern: charter committed-clean by byte-integrity, launch-path code at HEAD, model hash asserted, charter schema parsed at preflight, dataset file sha256 verified against this charter before reading, report-exists refusal

stop_condition: no analytic outcome is computed until this frozen charter is explicitly approved; approval is the D9 sign-off
